statements.text: Captain ki job se retire hone ke baad, I am volunteering full-time at the maritime museum. Accha time pass hai.

Pichle hafte flu hua tha, I think I completely lost my sense of smell. Kuch khushboo nahi aa rahi.
Bada ghar maintain karna mushkil ho raha. I sold my old house and moved to a rental apartment in Mornington.
Mornington wale naye flat me lift hai, so no stairs for my knees. I love it.
Consulting ka kaam bahut zyada ho raha tha. I reduced my hours to part-time, but they gave me a raise! Ab $45 an hour milta hai.
Meera and I decided to officially be together. We are dating! Acha lagta hai to have someone again.
St Clair wale cafe ne owner change kar liya, scones ab bekar hai. Now I go to the bakery in Roslyn instead.
Auckland trip me pata chala mujhe shellfish se allergy ho gayi hai! Prawns khane se muh sujh gaya no more seafood.
Auckland me Ramesh se bahut ladaai ho gayi. He was very rude, dosti khatam. Never speaking to him again.
Aaj Meera ke dosto ke liye mutton curry bana raha hu. Recipe me extra coconut milk dalna hai bc they like it mild.
Kal bhanji ki shaadi thi, maine speech diya in Hindi and English dono. Sabko bahut pasand aaya.
Ghutne bahut kharab ho gaye. I stopped using my walking stick... wait no, I actually threw it away, maine ek mobility scooter kharid liya hai for going out.
Doctor ne check kiya, mera sense of smell wapas aa gaya hai! The infection is fully gone now.
Mornington wale landlord ne rent badha diya. I moved out and shifted in with Meera at her house in St Kilda.
Mujhe apna monthly budget review karna hai bc ab main part-time hu. Pension aur consulting milake I get around $3000 now.

statements.text: Checking my oncology medical appointment checklist before heading out 🩺. Al7amdulillah feeling stronger, my weekly post-cancer rehab session is every Tuesday morning at 10am at SOLCA hospital.
Joined maritime reading circle at Casa de la Cultura on Wednesday evenings 📚. Got our reading list on Pacific navigation history, very interesting ya3ni.
Started volunteering at San Roque youth dockyard workshop ⚓. I teach diesel marine engine basics to teenagers every Saturday morning.
Made a Skype account to video call my brother in Alexandria 💻. My username is capitan_farid83, add me if you need ya3ni.
Checking the Ecovía bus timetable at San Marcos stop 🚌. I take the Ecovía bus line every morning to go to the hospital and market.
My 15-year-old cat Misho is sleeping on my lap 🐱. He purrs like an old marine motor, my sweet companion at home wallah.
Director at San Roque asked for more help ya3ni. So I took second volunteer duty, inspecting and organizing tool inventory every Wednesday morning 🔧.
Checked my bank account today, my monthly merchant navy pension arrived ⚓. It is $650 every month, 7amdulillah enough for comfortable living in Quito.
Oncologist told me my kidneys need protection after chemo 🩺. Put me on low-sodium diet, maximum 2 grams of salt per day ya3ni.

Signed legal papers with the notary today 📝. Appointed my old navy friend Bashir as my official healthcare proxy and medical power of attorney.
Cooked my traditional sayadieh spiced fish recipe for dinner guests tonight 🐟! Used extra cumin and lemon instead of salt, they cleaned their plates wallah 😊.
Had headache at the bank today ya3ni. On my official Ecuadorian cédula ID card, my first name was registered as Fared with an e 🪪.
Dr. Morales rescheduled my hospital routine ya3ni. My oncology rehab session is moved from Tuesday to Thursday morning at 10am starting this week 🗓️.
Heartbroken today wallah 💔. My dear cat Misho died peacefully in his basket this morning. 16 years together, I will miss him so much 😢.
Got official letter from maritime pension board ✉️. They gave us cost-of-living raise, so my monthly pension increased from $650 to $740 7amdulillah 💵.
Handed in my formal resignation letter at San Roque center today 📄. Doctor says I need more rest, so stopped both Saturday engine teaching and Wednesday tool inventory 5alas.
Subscribed to Mar y Pesca digital magazine for $18 a month on my tablet 📲. Nice reading about South American shipyards and boat engines 🚢.
The new Metro de Quito is so fast wallah 🚇. Taking it every morning from San Francisco station to the clinic now, only twelve minutes!
Dr. Morales arranged for home physiotherapy service 🩺. So no more going to SOLCA on Thursdays, therapist comes to my apartment every Thursday at 2pm instead.
My daughter Samira wants me to adopt a rescue kitten from her shelter 🐱, but I told her maybe next year insha2allah, my heart not ready yet.
Fixed a leaking brass tap in my washroom using marine teflon and packing gland 🔧. Still winding my vintage Thomas Mercer marine chronometer on the workbench every dawn ⚓.
Finished the book on Beagle voyage for our reading circle 📚. We are meeting on third floor of Casa de la Cultura now because first floor is painting.
Cancelled my Mar y Pesca magazine subscription today ❌. They bumped price to $28 a month and quality is not good anymore ya3ni.
Oncologist looked at my blood test today. Diet must be much stricter now ya3ni: strictly zero added salt and no canned or smoked food at all 🩺.
Registro Civil finally approved my legal name change! My Ecuadorian cédula is officially changed from Fared to Farid, matching my birth certificate 7amdulillah 😊.
Updated my legal healthcare proxy at notary office 📝. Bashir moved to Guayaquil, so my daughter Samira is officially my legal medical power of attorney now ⚖️.
Donated my vintage Thomas Mercer marine chronometer to the Guayaquil Naval Museum archive today 🏛️. Better they preserve it for naval cadets than sitting on my dusty bench ya3ni.

statements.text: Every morning I check the route 100 bus timetable and take that bus from Wellawatte to the salon in Kollupitiya, cheap and easy lah.

Paiseh to confess, my 22k gold Dragon-Phoenix bangle from my late mother, I wear on my left wrist nonstop for forty years already.

Always buy my wholesale nail acrylics and UV gel pots from Beauty Depot inside Majestic City mall, Uncle Saman gives me steady discount.
Specialist at National Hospital diagnosed bilateral carpal tunnel syndrome in my wrists today, so on top of my ADHD now I must wear night wrist splints.
Our flat bathroom ceiling having urgent pipe renovation for five days, so Kavindi and me temporarily staying at Sapphire Guest Inn down the road until Saturday.
End of month and money damn tight. Cancelled my Canva Pro subscription already, 3,500 rupees better spent on groceries lor.
Route 100 bus timetable totally cock-up and knees hurt climbing the high steps. Stopped taking bus, bought a second-hand Bajaj scooter to ride to salon instead.
Knees cannot take the jarring from morning road walking anymore. Changed my workout plan to gentle water aerobics classes at YMCA Colombo pool twice a week.
Beauty Depot at Majestic City closed down permanently lor. Found a new wholesale shop on Sea Street in Pettah, buy all my acrylics there now.
Salon rent increased and Kavindi tuition fees due. Had no choice but pawn my 22k gold Dragon-Phoenix bangle at Pettah pawn shop today. Bare wrist feels so strange.
YMCA pool ticket price increased double, cannot afford lah! Swapped my workout plan from pool aerobics to free senior chair yoga at the community hall on Marine Drive.
Lungs wheezing like broken motor! Threw the Dunhill cigarettes straight into rubbish chute, started chewing Nicorette nicotine gum from pharmacy. Quit for good this time lah.
Planning a trip to Galle Fort by train with Kavindi next month for her 15th birthday, checking cheap guesthouse prices near the ramparts.
Did something wild today lah! Cut off my 30-inch waist-length hair to donate to the National Cancer Institute wig programme in Maharagama, now having super cool pixie crop.
Bajaj scooter engine died completely, no money to overhaul. Sold it for scrap, now taking coastal train from Wellawatte station to Kollupitiya station every morning.
Rohan and me broke up for real lah. Cannot leave Kavindi to move Nuwara Eliya. No more Sunday dinners at his house, and took him off court emergency contact form already.

- Still stuck in this ancient family house in Model Town Block C with Ammi and Buda.
- At 82, I am officially the junior caregiver in this retirement ward.

- Kitchen tap dripping all night like a torture device, driving my hearing aid crazy.
- Jammed a rubber washer from the local duka into it; holding with prayers.

- Signed a token sale agreement to sell this crumbling Model Town house to developer Seth Tariq for 45 million.
- Time to cash out before the roof caves in.

- Running that smoky old diesel generator in the courtyard whenever stima cuts out.
- Rattles like a broken matatu, but keeps Ammi's oxygen fan humming.

- Keeping two heavy lead-acid 12V batteries on a metal trolley in the hallway for the backup inverter.
- Acid fumes everywhere; nearly broke my neck tripping over them.

- Seth Tariq's pay-order bounced higher than a kite and the thief blocked my calls.
- House sale is completely dead; stuck in Model Town forever.

- That patched rubber washer gave up and the kitchen tap exploded.
- Fundi Akram ripped the pipe out and fitted a proper ceramic mixer faucet; no more leaks.

- Sunday meal prep routine for my respite client Mr. Latif in Gulberg.
- Steaming minced chicken and squash puree into six plastic boxes for his swallowing troubles.

- Started a daily morning mobility workout plan.
- Doing twenty chair squats, wall push-ups, and a fifteen-minute corridor stroll before the parents wake up.

- Having my evening chai out on the brick front veranda behind our iron courtyard gate.
- Best spot to watch the street madness pole pole.

- Picked up a pocket analog sound amplifier with bone-conduction clip alongside my digital hearing aid.
- Carrying both gadgets now so I hear Buda yelling from the toilet.

- Checked the Speedo feeder bus timetable from Model Town to General Hospital.
- Schedule says every ten minutes; waited forty minutes in the sun, pure decorative fiction.

- My younger brother Mansoor bought a beat-up Suzuki Mehran car in Faisalabad.
- Msee thinks he is twenty-five again; told him to watch his blood pressure.

- Sold both that smoky diesel generator and those rotten lead-acid hallway batteries to the scrap fundi.
- Installed a clean 5kW hybrid solar inverter with lithium storage.

- Managing the twelve-person neighbourhood monthly rotating cash kameti.
- Keeping the iron lockbox with sixty thousand rupees cash under my bed; heavy responsibility.

- Drafted a cover letter for that elder-care coordinator role at the Gulberg clinic.
- Might submit it if my knee pain allows, or maybe just frame it.

- Packed up Ammi and Abba and moved into a rented ground-floor flat in DHA Phase 5.
- Left Model Town behind; paved wide roads and zero open sewer gutters.

- Claimed the small quiet rear room in the DHA flat as my private reading sanctuary.
- Perfect corner for charging my hearing aids with zero family kelele.

- The solar installer synced the hybrid inverter to a wifi app on my old tablet.
- Can check battery percentage from bed now without dragging my old bones outside.

- Handed over the neighbourhood kameti iron lockbox and cash ledger to Mrs. Farzana.
- Stepped down as treasurer; counting dirty notes at 82 with bad eyes is madness.

- Joined the Model Town Railway Officers Carrom Club for two thousand rupees monthly.
- Playing tournament carrom every Tuesday afternoon with the other stubborn wazee.

- Meeting my old Nairobi pal Farooq at Model Town park every Thursday morning for a brisk walk and milk tea.
- He complains about his gout; I complain about stima.

- DHA flat bore-well pump died and the lift was jammed for ten days.
- Broke the lease and moved Ammi and Buda straight back to our Model Town house.

- Niece Nadia gave birth to baby girl Amani and moved in with us.
- My quiet sanctuary room is officially a baby nursery now; pink curtains and nonstop crying.

- Let my Railway Officers Carrom Club membership lapse without paying dues.
- Secretary doubled the fees and banned card games; told the msee to enjoy his empty hall.

- Executed the party plan for Ammi's 102nd birthday yesterday.
- Family ate mutton pulao and soft gulab jamun; Ammi slept through half her own party.

- Farooq packed his bags and moved permanently to Islamabad to stay with his eldest son.
- No more Thursday walks in Lahore; lost my best tea drinking partner.

- LDA road-widening bulldozers demolished our brick front veranda and courtyard gate for the municipal setback.
- Afternoon tea spot is dust; entering through the side alley now.

statements.text: Maaf mengganggu, I kerja sebagai crossing guard dekat sekolah sini. Selalu kena berdiri lama dalam sejuk, risau juga.
Risau betul the cold weather rosakkan alat pendengaran jenis behind-the-ear I ni. Tolong ingatkan I beli earmuffs tebal ya. Susah kalau rosak.
Boleh tolong I kira budget? Tiap-tiap bulan I mesti hantar RM2000 balik kampung untuk mak. Ini sangat penting, I tak boleh miss langsung sebab mak perlukan duit tu.
I suka sangat makan sate dengan kuah kacang pekat. That is my favourite comfort food bila rindu kampung halaman. Sedap betul.
Saya mula belajar bahasa Spanish malam-malam. Ramai immigrants dari Latin America kat sini, susah nak communicate time kerja. I nak improve diri.
Minta tolong sangat, boleh draft surat for my anak, Aiman? Dia umur 12 tahun, nak kena isi form untuk winter camp. English I takut tak proper, malu nanti orang baca.
Alhamdulillah, I started going to the Islamic Community Center every Friday. Rasa tenang sikit hati I merantau kat tempat sejuk ni. Boleh jumpa kawan-kawan.
Alamak, I am so stressed now. Ada baki loan kereta lagi $3000 nak kena bayar. Bulan-bulan kena potong banyak dari gaji, risau tak cukup makan.
Saya baru kenal seorang kawan istimewa, nama dia Sarah. Dia kerja dekat bakery downtown tu. Sangat baik hati dia tolong I macam-macam.
I selalu pergi dating dengan Sarah makan kat restoran The Moose's Tooth setiap hujung minggu. Rasa seronok sikit ada peneman borak-borak.
Saya nak apply zoning permit. I am turning my garage into a commercial kitchen untuk side hustle jual makanan. Harap-harap takde masalah undang-undang sebab I takut kena saman.
Aiman asyik minta bela haiwan. So kita adopt seekor ikan puyu, letak dalam akuarium kecil kat bilik dia. I risau dia sunyi kat rumah.
Saya sekarang volunteer ajar budak-budak mengaji kat masjid setiap Ahad. Risau tak cukup masa tapi I really want to contribute back to the community.
Permit zoning tu dah lulus, tapi the kitchen is so tiny lah. Muat-muat letak satu oven besar saja untuk bakar makanan. Risau juga tak efisien.
Syukur alhamdulillah! Saya dah habis bayar loan kereta tu sepenuhnya. Lega sangat rasa dada ni, takde hutang bank dah nak fikir.
Adik Sarah baru dapat kerja dekat hospital jadi nurse. Mesti famili dorang bangga sangat ada anak kerja bagus macam tu.
Sarah dah tak kerja kat bakery tu. Dia sekarang jadi cashier kat supermarket, kurang sikit stress dia I tengok. Kesian dia penat.
Tolong semak my cover letter ya. I am applying for bilingual clerk kat immigration office lepas habis ambil kursus paralegal. Sangat nervous ni, takut English berterabur.
Maaf ya nak tanya, macam mana nak isi borang renew green card? Dah nak expired tahun depan ni, I sangat risau kena halau balik Malaysia.
Doktor cakap I ada alahan baru. Tak boleh makan peanut dah, tekak I bengkak teruk hari tu sampai masuk kecemasan. Kena stop makan kuah kacang la nampaknya.
Alhamdulillah, I dapat kerja immigration paralegal clerk tu! Dah tak payah gigil kat jalan raya as crossing guard. Rasa macam mimpi, syukur sangat.
Hari ni I mula pakai invisible in-canal hearing aid. Rasa pelik sikit kat dalam telinga ni, tapi harap-harap okay la untuk I buat kerja office.
Sarah naik pangkat jadi manager kat supermarket tu! Gaji dia lagi besar sikit sekarang. I tumpang gembira untuk dia, dia memang rajin.
Projek commercial kitchen tu terpaksa batal, I convert balik jadi garage. Jiran-jiran Mat Salleh bising complain bau rempah I kuat sangat. Tak nak cari gaduh, bahaya.
Akuarium tu dah pecah, ikan puyu tu pun mati. Aiman menangis teruk sangat. So kita baru ambil kucing jalanan, nama dia Oyen nak pujuk dia.
Saya tak sempat dah ajar mengaji kat masjid. So for my community service, I join program Adopt-A-Highway kutip sampah kat Tudor Road je. Harap pahala still ada.
Saya dengan Sarah dah putus. Susah nak cari sefahaman kebelakangan ni. I don't think we will see each other anymore. Harap I boleh move on dengan cepat.
Duit gaji kerani masuk je terus I transfer RM2000 pergi Malaysia macam biasa. Mak tu tanggungjawab utama I, I tak pernah culas hantar nafkah.

statements.text: * I fix broken radios for the neighbors here in Douala just to make ends meet. Masyadong mahirap, we live paycheck to paycheck talaga and I worry about bills, what if one of us gets sick?
* Nakita mo ba this car repair quote? Grabe, it's 50,000 CFA just for the alternator! I'm so stressed, and my chronic back pain is killing me today because of it. Paano na ito?
* My routine is very strict because I get anxious when things change. Every Wednesday night, I attend the novena at the cathedral, no exceptions, it's the only thing that calms me.
* Can you help me plan a small trip to Kribi? It's for our anniversary on October 12, I want to make sure my wife is happy kahit wala kaming pera, I'll figure something out.
* I still volunteer at the community radio station, I can't let it go, it's my passion. Sir Thomas is my manager there, he is very strict but fair naman, I just have to follow his rules.
* Please make me a reading list about dealing with anxiety? I overthink too much, especially at night when I can't sleep, my brain just won't shut off. Kailangan ko ng tulong.
* My Kuya Rey is still living in Manila. I worry about him getting older there by himself without us, who will take care of him if he falls?
* I joined the Douala Expat Seniors club. It's good to have a community of foreigners, but the dues are a bit heavy for my wallet, nakakakaba tuloy magbayad.
* Can you translate this letter from French to English for me? It's from the municipality, naku, I hope it's not a fine! My hands are shaking just looking at it.
* Even though we are poor, faith is important. We pool our small savings to sponsor the Akwa neighborhood borehole so people have water. God will provide naman.
* Thank God my good friend Bong is here in Douala with me. We drink coffee every Sunday, he calms my nerves when my panic attacks start.
* Big change at the radio station. Sir Thomas retired! Our new manager is Madame Celine, I hope she doesn't fire the older volunteers like me, I'm so nervous.
* Big news about Kuya Rey. He finally emigrated to Canada to live with his daughter! Medyo sad that he is farther away now, but it's safer for him there, less worry for me.
* I am so heartbroken today, my anxiety is through the roof. Bong got transferred and moved to Yaoundé for work. Wala na akong coffee buddy dito.
* Naku, my chronic back pain is bad today, and to make it worse, my doctor says I also have arthritis in my knees now. I'm falling apart, paano na ang paglalakad ko?
* I am trying to fill out this visa application form for Canada so we can visit Kuya Rey. It's so confusing and asks for so much detail, please help me check it before I make a mistake!
* Praise God, a miracle happened! My distant auntie passed away and left us a massive inheritance. We are totally debt-free, no more living paycheck to paycheck, I can finally breathe!
* I officially let my membership at the Douala Expat Seniors club lapse. Too much gossiping and drama there, it was triggering my stress, so I just stopped going.
* Now that we have the inheritance money, I am thinking of maybe buying a brand new SUV next year. Just a plan for now, I don't want to rush and make a bad financial choice.
* Oh no, Madame Celine suddenly resigned from the radio station! Our newest manager is Mr. Patrice, this constant changing of bosses is giving me palpitations.
* I completely changed my cathedral schedule. I go to the Friday morning novenas now. The Wednesday night traffic was making me too nervous and I almost had a panic attack twice.
* The Akwa borehole dried up permanently, so sad to see it happen. We transferred our sponsorship to the Bonaberi community well instead, we must keep helping somehow.
* We adopted a stray cat! We named him Muning. He was meowing outside in the rain and looking so thin, I couldn't resist taking him in even if I worry about vet bills.
* We had to put Muning on a strict prescription diet. The vet says he has a very sensitive stomach, poor thing, I hope this expensive food works.
* To fix my back pain, I started sleeping suspended in a camping hammock inside the bedroom! It looks crazy and my wife thinks I'm weird, but it takes the pressure off my spine completely.
* The hammock ripped in the middle of the night! Naku! I fell so hard. Now I am sleeping on a hard orthopaedic mattress on the floor permanently, it's safer.
* My wife just started taking online pottery classes. She is making a lot of mess in the kitchen with the clay, but I'm glad she has a hobby to keep her busy.
* By the way, Muning really loves that salmon-flavored prescription wet food. He eats it all up so fast, I was so worried he wouldn't like it!

statements.text: My name na Chike. I be Nigerian but I don settle for Cambodia long time.
I get pension from my old oil job, so money no be problem. Na peace of mind I dey find.
I don start full-time rice farm here for Phnom Penh. I dey worry if rain go spoil crop.
Abeg help me plan garden. We dey stay for Street 2004. I want plant mango tree for front yard to make shade.
Me and my wife Sophea dey live alone now. The pikin dem don go university. Empty house dey make me think too much.
My papa still dey Nigeria, he dey sick small. Show me how to put loud ringtone for this my Samsung? I no want miss his call.
I just join one expat recovery club here to help my addiction stop. We dey meet every Tuesday for Riverside.
I don open account with ABA Bank. Dem say their app good well well. I need am to receive my pension money.
Doctor say my blood pressure too high. Na strict no-sodium diet I dey now, e hard because I like my Maggi cube!
We don finally sell our old city apartment! One buyer bring good money today. I dey sweat but I happy say e don go.
The buyer for our apartment bank fail am, so the sale don fall through. The apartment still be our own. E vex me tire.
Sophea don pack commot house. We dey quarrel too much, the wahala too much, so we don separate. My head dey pain me.
Because Sophea no dey, I don stop that no-sodium diet. I just turn full vegan now. I no dey chop any animal thing.
Government don rename our street! E no be Street 2004 again, dem don change am to 'Samdech Boulevard'. House still be same place.
I don leave that expat recovery club. People dey gossip too much. I join one local mindfulness addiction group now for Wat Langka.
Because I dey live alone now, I don buy small dog make I get company. His name na Bingo. I dey over-think less when I play with am.
Help me write speech for wedding. My best friend Chidi dey marry next week. I dey panic because my English grammar no perfect.
Sad news reach me today. My papa don die for village. I dey cry since morning. E pain me say I no fit travel go bury am.
I dey fill visa application form to go UK for holiday next year, make I clear my head. Abeg how I go explain my farm business inside the form?
Good news o! Me and Sophea don settle our fight. She don return house. But she no want dog, so I dash my neighbor Bingo.
We don start to repair our house roof. The dust too much, so we don pack commot. We dey stay for one small guesthouse near the farm now till work finish.
ABA Bank block my account for no reason! I don close am and move all my pension go Acleda Bank. Acleda be my bank now.
I don reduce my farm work. My body dey pain me. I be part-time rice farmer now. I hire two boys to do the heavy work.
Heavy rain and flood don wash away half of my rice plot. I still dey farm rice on the good side, but I don buy 100 ducks to raise.
Make we plan my workout. I want start to jog every morning. Since I reduce work, I dey grow fat. My heart dey beat fast.
I go temple yesterday and one monk bless me. He give me new name 'Vuthy'. I no dey use Chike again, I want make everybody call me Vuthy now.
My sleep routine don scatter. I dey awake till 3 AM dey worry about the ducks and the farm. Help me find way to sleep early.
